Not bad! This was a good alternative to Viso, since it's unavailable on Google Play now. The only downside is it's tracking. You have to find a good spot in your room where it can see you clearly, and your clothes don't blend in with the room. You have to stand out well so the camera can see you better! Also, there's ads every 10 minutes or so lol. Still, a good starting place for people new to Full Body Tracking!
